title: Emissions Calculator
subtitle: Monthly data collection for Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions. Enter activity data by source, review cumulative totals, and submit for blockchain verification.

charts.cumulativeSub: Running total through each month of FY 2026

table.subtitle: Monthly data collection with source-level breakdown. Click any row to expand and edit.

toast.allAlreadySubmitted: All months already submitted or verified

methodModal.title: Calculation Methodology
methodModal.subtitle: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (2004 Revised), ISO 14064-1:2018
methodModal.coreFormula: Emissions (tCO₂e) = Activity Data × Emission Factor × GWP
methodModal.note: All emissions are reported in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent (tCO₂e) using AR5 Global Warming Potentials. Base year recalculation is triggered by structural changes exceeding 5% of total emissions.
methodModal.assurance4: Aligns with CDP, GRI 305, TCFD / IFRS S2 disclosure requirements
